repairs.root_cause: A universal colon/strip/comment parser differed from the pinned native per-role sscanf grammars.
repairs.implemented: Native fgets 1023-byte chunks; untrimmed keys and width limits; battle first non-whitespace value/import token; login and char full value tails; char control characters become underscores; map inline comments/tab boundary and trailing-space removal. Recursive imports preserve parser and native order; bound-file, cycle, depth and canonical relative-root path guards remain fail-closed.

repairs.root_cause: Owned selected attachments were denied solely for generic bridge NetworkMode and blank EndpointID.
repairs.implemented: Accept bridge only alongside the selected owned-network identity, exact role/project/service IDs, owned membership, matching running NetworkID and member IP, and unique running addresses. Explicit blank selected EndpointID may pair with blank/absent member EndpointID on bridge; nonempty endpoint identity still must match. Missing selected endpoint or wrong populated stopped NetworkID denies. No unknown engine metadata is defaulted.
repairs.new_positive_path: Default adapter and unchanged helper chain execute the six synthetic lifecycle transitions with missing stopped attachments, changing start IPs, blank bridge endpoints and absent member EndpointID.

repairs.root_cause: PORTS[map] was 16122 while native configuration and publication were 15121.
repairs.implemented: Use literal login 16900, char 16121, map 15121. Require bound role configuration and exact configured/public publication agreement. Existing PID-owned socket classification uses these same constants; wrong observed listeners do not become ready.
